scope: Pure CPU execution of before/after animation source. No browser, actual rig deformation, pixels, clipping, complete ear-root attachment, subjective smoothness or real-time FPS was tested. Native gait equations are used as an explicitly constructed input; captured legacy native phases are separately labelled.
